notes.title: Patch 2.0.0 is LIVE Now
notes.notes:
So, in the last 3 days since release, I've been looking and waiting to see what kind of issues people find, and have addressed the once found so far here:

[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[i]- Doors in the Warped Hallway being able to be opened, resulting in the Player falling into the abyss if they walk through them[/i]

[i]- Fixed a bug with playing the game, going into the menu, and the Levels not resetting, locking players out from continuing their gameplay.[/i]


These are all the bugs so far found. I will patch the game more as more bugs are found, so make sure to report any bugs you find on the Discord:

Discord: https://discord.gg/TWagPZrG96

notes.title: Help for anyone stuck (SPOILERS)
notes.notes:
So, a lot of people apparently have been playing the demo so far, and it seems a few have been getting stuck especially on the Clock Puzzle, so a small hint I will give here is:

[b]Look at the clocks in the hallway (E to interact) and see what times they chime at.[/b]

This hint should helpfully help anyone whose stuck on that puzzle. I have already implemented a hint inside the game (current version, not released) and that will be part of the full game.

If you still need help, make sure to join the Discord to ask any questions and I'll be happy to help!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/XSZ9YqsFf5

Best Regards,
LenexTL

notes.title: Major Updates about the game and steam page
notes.notes:
Been a long time since I have made an official announcement here, but here I am!

In this post I mainly want to talk about a few things, such as changes to the game, store page, and unofficial release date.


[b]Changes to the Game and Steam Page[/b]

This steam page originally was made for 'The Darkest Paths', but as you can probably tell, that has changed. Due to a few reasons, if you have not watched any of the videos on my YouTube Channel, the Darkest Paths development has been paused for the time being, and I have been working on a different game / IP, which the steam page has been changed to now.

This game / IP is actually based on a book series I wrote when I was 18 (and almost published as well), and the game takes place in the same universe as the book series, but in a different time and place. Just wanted to share that cool little fact here. :3



[b]Unofficial Release Date[/b]

Some of you here have had this game wishlisted for a REALLLLYYYY long time, and to those who were looking forward to the Darkest Paths, I apologize. But to those who are excited for this new IP, yay! 

This new game has been in development for around 6-8 months now, and a lot has been changed, added, and re-made during the development process. Recently, I have decided to expand the game CONSIDERABLY because I want to give people the best possible experience and play time (in terms of hours to what people pay), but of course, expanding a game increases development time.

However, the game is surprisingly enough quite close to being done. There are a few sections which have to be made and optimized, yes, but a majority of the BIG things have been completed and tested, and with that in mind, I am aiming for a release date of around [b]end of May[/b] to [b]Early / Mid July.[/b]

Now, this is ONLY A ROUGH GUESS of when I am HOPING to release the game, but hopefully the game will be done around the end of next month, April, and then I can do playtests to find any bugs / issues / exploits and fix them before officially releasing the game.

But yeah, that is all from me today. If you have not followed my YouTube channel, where I upload Devlogs and post updates quite often, please consider to do so, but until next time, cya!

YouTube: www.youtube.com/@LenexTL

notes.title: Updates Regarding Playtesting
notes.notes:
Hey, long time no see! 

Today I want to announce some things regarding our last post where we announced that we'd do Playtests for the game.

So, getting right into it, we have decided that instead of doing Beta Playtesting's or etc, we are going to release a free demo of the game, which will take place in the 1st Half of the 1st Chapter, and that you can download on your Steam Page. 

This demo will work as a way for us to get a general idea of what people like so far and dislike, any bugs they find that we can fix before the full release, and also give players a small insight into what the game will be like, so everyone can see whether it is for them or not! 

There is currently not EXACT release date for the demo, as things are still being developed and worked on, however we do believe that around the end of May, or May 30th, will be the release date for the demo.

We believe that due to how fast we have made progress in the last couple of weeks, and with how things have been going so far.

I also want to mention that we have a YouTube Channel now. On that channel we upload Devlogs of the progress and what we have made, as well as discussing some things about the game you would not hear anywhere else. So if you are interested please check it out! 

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCywb9qycjjx566VeQdGBdrg

We are also currently working on getting a website, but that will still take a while, so that will be all for today!

Until next time, goodbye!

notes.title: The Darkest Paths - Playtesting
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we are here to say and announce a few things! 

First of all, we have recently achieved over 100 Wishlist's, which might not seem like a whole lot, but to us is still something amazing, and something that makes us incredibly happy and motivated to keep working on the game! 

But now to stop talking about sentimental things, and address the main reason for this post, Playtesting or Playtests. As most people know, before releasing a game you want to play it to find any bugs or other issues that can impact and affect the player experience negatively. With that in mind, we want to do the same thing, which is why he have decided to do such Playtests later this year. If you are interested in participating, helping at finishing the 1st Chapter, and getting an early glimpse at the game, please join our discord to be notified on when exactly the playtests will start!

Our Discord: https://discord.gg/txASMwstMa


"But when exactly will the Playtests begin, and for how long will they go on for?" is probably something you'd ask. Well, there is no definitive or set date yet as to when Playtests will start, as before we start them we want to ensure that most of the issues have already been fixed, to make the testing easier. However, from our development progress and speed, we are estimating that Playtests will probably start around June/July (These dates might change).

And that is basically all we want to say for now. We want to give another big thank you to all the people that have so far wishlisted our game, and we are excited to show you the end results once the game is done. 

Until next time, 
AtranonStudios
